stem:
A part of quadratic function \(g\) is graphed on the grid.

What is the domain of the part of the function shown?

options.label: A
options.text: All real numbers greater than or equal to \(-4\) and less than or equal to 5

options.label: B
options.text: All real numbers greater than or equal to \(-1\) and less than or equal to 3

options.label: C
options.text: All real numbers greater than or equal to \(-6\) and less than or equal to 6

options.label: D
options.text: All real numbers greater than or equal to \(-2\) and less than or equal to 3

visual_elements: coordinate plane with points at (-2,5) and (3,1) connected by segment of a parabola
